answer_1.quote: Simultaneous speech translation converts input speech into translation output before the speech input utterance ends, enabling low-latency interaction . The translation can be text or speech, classified as Simul-S2TT or Simul-S2ST.
answer_1.outputs: target-language speech tokens and synthesised speech

answer_2.quote: ASR-BLEU For Simul-S2ST, the ASR-BLEU toolkit was used to evaluate the translation quality, which transcribes the synthesised speech into text before calculating SacreBLEU with the reference text.
